Hi HeliumDeploy Team,

I am writing regarding my order (Shop····).

I received a notification on November 4th stating that my item is on the
way. However, as of today, November 6th, I have not received any updates or
contact from the courier service (such as DHL or FedEx).

Could you please provide the latest update on this shipment and let me know
which courier company is handling the delivery?

Thank you,
Suman C.
Handed to the team · Carrier not named on the order; I can't confirm which courier it is without gues

Hi Suman,

Your Bitfortun BS-4 has shipped. It left the manufacturer on November 4 with tracking number ····, and you can follow it here: (tracking link hidden)

The courier isn't named on the shipment record, and I'd rather not guess. A colleague is picking that up today and will email you the courier's name. The first carrier scans on international parcels often take a few days to appear, so a quiet tracking page at this stage is normal.

Best regards,
Sarah H. Support

Hi Sarah,

Thank you.

Hello T.,
Any update on the shipping status for order Shop···· yet?

Thanks,
Suman

Hi Suman,

Nothing new has come through on our side since your last email. Your Bitfortun BS-4 left the manufacturer on November 4 with tracking number ····, and you can follow it here: (tracking link hidden)

The courier isn't named on the shipment yet. I don't want to guess, so your question is still with the team. They pick it up Monday at 10am ET and will email you the courier's name. On international parcels, the first carrier scans often take a few days to show.

Best regards,
Sarah

Hi Sarah,

I have received the shipment. DHL delivered it quickly here to (address hidden).
The Bitfortun BS-4 miner is running well, and I have updated it with the
latest HARLO OS driver.

Everything looks good so far. Thank you for your prompt responses and for
keeping me updated. I appreciate your help.

Best regards,
Suman
